fields.label: Party

fields.description: If this correspondent is renamed, replaced or removed in Paperless NGX, this option applies the change in ERPNext: it renames the display name of the linked master record (e.g. Customer/Supplier) and relinks or clears the party field on business documents. Switched off automatically for party types whose display name cannot be written back (e.g. "Contact", whose display name is calculated from several fields). Syncing from ERPNext to Paperless NGX is independent of this option and always runs.
fields.label: Bidirectional
